purpose: Preserve specialised descriptive metadata while the execution contract uses the unchanged canonical OKF publication vocabulary. These details do not confer authority, review or release acceptance.
mapping_notes: Repository lifecycle experimental-preview maps to active; publication scope remains the experimental candidate described in the canonical limitations, not a production release.

The former context-discovery and repository-governance planes map to runtime and release. A browser plane names the offline retained-evidence check while real-browser observation remains a separate requirement.

Source families mixing official files with extraction, classification or interpretation use mixed authority. CPAG and legislation references remain external-reference. The semantic pilot remains editorial and unreviewed.
Rights status mixed preserves source-specific licences and exceptions; CPAG is restricted. None of these mappings is a new clearance or review.
Generated boundaries describe aggregate runtime directories; their semantic, reader, relationship and search members remain separately classified by okf.semantic.json and okf.delivery.json.
The manual GitHub repository target uses the CI workflow as its candidate gate. Existing Git bytes are promoted through reviewed PR merge; no hosted application deployment is implied.

The previous installed-browser requirement maps to real-browser and remains required. browser-evidence-check checks retained observation identity only; it does not create or substitute for browser evidence.
Original verification strings become explicit immutable journeys. Historical pilot observations remain historical and cannot establish full-corpus or later Explorer acceptance.
Original command origin labels are preserved below and conservatively normalised to unreviewed, except the four pre-existing reviewed-local-guidance commands.
The relative-path-only semantic input register identifies the public authored files present at repair. It is not a source-text hash manifest or proof of legal or semantic completeness.

sensitivity.assessment: Public guidance and source-authored worked examples; no claimant case data acquired.

limitations: Machine text extraction can damage reading order; chapter 83 has known letter-spacing defects.

original_source_family_descriptions.authority: project-authored reference to pinned published catalogue

rights.status: MIT-original-references; source-level rights apply to linked materials

limitations: No content hashes or exhaustive personal-data assessment are asserted by this relative-path register. Private email, research and browser scratch directories are outside the declared patterns and are excluded.
This separate local descriptive format is not an extension of the canonical publication schema. Only okf.publication.json supplies the executable publication contract.
Values under original_* preserve prior wording for migration traceability; they are not current canonical statuses or successful gate results.
